newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Trans Tasman plans split - NZ Herald.
newsitem.headline: Trans Tasman plans split - NZ Herald.

text.p: Trans Tasman Properties is looking to raise $A180 million ($NZ205 million) through the float in Australia of its property portfolio in that country, the NZ Herald reported on Friday.
Listing is understood to be planned for January, with the public issue opening next month.
Most of the proceeds from the float will be used to reduce the group debt of Trans Tasman Properties.
Sources indicate that total debt will fall to $436 million from $NZ620 million, bringing the ratio of total debt to total assets to 38.3 percent from 55 percent.
Shareholders' funds are projected to be $685 million, boosting the proprietorship ratio to 60 percent from 45.2 percent.
The Australian vehicle will have a clean balance sheet with no borrowings.
Trans Tasman will retain a 42 percent holding in the company, which is set to be called Australia Growth Properties.
